chat.fallback.title: AI is unavailable — continue manually
chat.fallback.description: Your input is preserved. Every AI path can degrade to a manual, auditable one — take over with catalog search and filters.
chat.fallback.reason.timeoutDescription: The assistant took too long. Your query is preserved — open catalog or data-asset search with the same input.

chat.error.timeout: The assistant timed out. Continue with manual search below.
